{"actions":[{"type":"success_contract","objective":"Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background and expose an Alpine login prompt reachable at telnet 127.0.0.1 6665, then block until readiness is confirmed.","required_artifacts":["A running QEMU process using /app/alpine.iso","A launch log or receipt showing the VM started successfully","A probe receipt showing telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 reaches a login prompt"],"required_behaviors":["QEMU must remain running in the background after launch","Host port 6665 must forward to the guest console/login service","A connection to 127.0.0.1:6665 must display a login prompt before finalization"],"known_invalid_patterns":["Only verifying that files exist","Only checking that QEMU is installed","Only confirming the port is open without seeing a login prompt","Launching QEMU in the foreground so the task is not left running","Using a different host port than 6665"],"verification_plan":["Inspect available image files and any prior receipts or helper scripts","Launch QEMU detached/backgrounded with hostfwd from 127.0.0.1:6665 to guest port 23 or equivalent console path","Probe 127.0.0.1:6665 until the login prompt is observed","Keep the VM running and record receipts for launch and probe"],"finalization_evidence_required":["Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command and process start","Receipt-backed evidence from a telnet/netcat probe showing the login prompt on 127.0.0.1:6665"],"notes":["If the ISO boots to a serial console instead of telnetd, adapt the QEMU console/forwarding so the user-facing telnet endpoint still reaches the login prompt."]},{"type":"working_checklist","items":["Search for existing receipts and any helper launch scripts","Inspect the image files to determine whether ISO or disk boot is needed","Launch QEMU in the background with logging enabled","Probe localhost:6665 for the login prompt","Leave the VM running once readiness is confirmed"]},{"type":"raw_bash","command":"set -euo pipefail
cd /app
printf 'Workspace files:\n'
ls -l
printf '\nExisting receipts (if any):\n'
find . -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name '*.receipt' -o -name '*.json' -o -name '*.log' -o -name '*receipt*' \) | sed 's#^./##' | sort | head -200","timeout_seconds":30,"description":"Inspect workspace files and prior receipts before launching QEMU"}]}

actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /app
printf 'Workspace files:\n'
ls -l
printf '\nExisting receipts (if any):\n'
find . -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name '*.receipt' -o -name '*.json' -o -name '*.log' -o -name '*receipt*' \) | sed 's#^./##' | sort | head -200
actions.description: Inspect workspace files and prior receipts before launching QEMU
